raw_response: {"sentences":[{"text":"From Notre-Dame, make your way over to Shakespeare and Company, about a seven-minute walk.","source_id":"GLUE_NAV","source_type":"glue","stop_idx":6},{"text":"In 1922, no publisher on earth would touch James Joyce's Ulysses — so Sylvia Beach printed it herself.","source_id":"fa5e44dc-25da-42c1-8aad-6e55cf06ce90","source_type":"beat","stop_idx":6,"also_cites":["1b9523b5-0b3e-4e0a-8c94-a056a0eb683c"]},{"text":"She'd opened her own shop, the first Shakespeare and Company, over on rue de l'Odeon three years earlier in 1919.","source_id":"1b9523b5-0b3e-4e0a-8c94-a056a0eb683c","source_type":"beat","stop_idx":6,"also_cites":["fa5e44dc-25da-42c1-8aad-6e55cf06ce90"]},{"text":"The one in front of you now is its descendant, at 37, rue de la Bucherie — scruffy, English-language, packed floor to ceiling with new and used books.","source_id":"fa5e44dc-25da-42c1-8aad-6e55cf06ce90","source_type":"beat","stop_idx":6},{"text":"Turn right as you step in for a whole wall of books about Paris.","source_id":"fa5e44dc-25da-42c1-8aad-6e55cf06ce90","source_type":"beat","stop_idx":6},{"text":"And if you can, come back on June the sixteenth — Bloomsday — when there are readings and wine-tasting upstairs.","source_id":"fa5e44dc-25da-42c1-8aad-6e55cf06ce90","source_type":"beat","stop_idx":6},{"text":"George Whitman opened this reincarnation in 1951, and he still let writers sleep among the shelves in exchange for a little work.","source_id":"1b9523b5-0b3e-4e0a-8c94-a056a0eb683c","source_type":"beat","stop_idx":6},{"text":"He called them Tumbleweeds.","source_id":"1b9523b5-0b3e-4e0a-8c94-a056a0eb683c","source_type":"beat","stop_idx":6}]}
